title: Surgical Anatomy
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Learn the two attachment fields as sets of offsets.
Plan the exposure from the nerve outwards rather than from the skin inwards.
Identify the nerve first in any posterolateral approach, and record that it was identified.
Treat the nerve as the constraint and the attachments as the problem.
Identify and protect the nerve before any other step, and say so in the operation note.
Plan every tunnel in the condyle together, including the cruciate tunnel where one is planned, and plan them in three dimensions.
Assess whether the lamina split is still available in a revision, and plan from bone where it is not.
Start proximally, in tissue that has not been entered, and work down to it.
